questions.q: What IP rating and special environmental variant does the Urovo RT40S offer for the toughest warehouse use?
o: IP68, with an optional −30°C cold-chain variant
questions.e: RT40S is rated IP68 with a 1.8 m drop spec and an optional −30°C cold-chain variant for freezers.

questions.q: Before pitching Urovo to an enterprise Zebra account, what must the team validate per model?
o: Android LTS/patch cadence and accessory parity (cradles, gun grip, vehicle mount)
questions.e: Enterprise buyers challenge Android version, patch cadence and accessory ecosystem. Validate LTS and accessory parity per model first.

questions.q: A customer running Zebra TC52 / TC57 mid-tier handhelds for retail and warehouse picking should be quoted which Urovo model?
questions.e: DT50 covers the TC52/57/58 mid-tier and adds mPOS credibility (Dreamtec deployment).
